title: Probabilistically checkable proof system
statement: For an alphabet $A$ and natural numbers $n$, $\ell$, and $r$, a probabilistically checkable proof system consists of a nonadaptive function tester with $r$ query positions whose address domain is the disjoint union of the $n$ input positions and the $\ell$ proof positions, and whose answers lie in $A$.
